card: Adds newly standardized BIP 174 test vectors covering invalid value sizes and sighash combinations to the functional test suite. Updates the PSBT combiner test runner to execute vectors in both forward and reversed input orders, verifying commutative combiner behavior. The changes sync test coverage with upstream BIP 174 specifications updated in bitcoin/bips#1971 and bitcoin/bips#2275. There are no dependencies.
changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; rebased or repushed without changing the approach or vectors.
evidence: Author description cites upstream BIP 174 test vector additions in bitcoin/bips#2275 and bitcoin/bips#1971
problem: Bitcoin Core's PSBT functional test suite lacks recently added test vectors from BIP 174 and does not assert that `combinepsbt` produces identical output regardless of the order in which PSBTs are passed.

risk.why: Only touches functional tests and test data; a bug would at most cause test failures without affecting node runtime.

summary: Adds new BIP 174 test vectors covering invalid value sizes and sighash combining to the functional PSBT test suite. Updates the combiner test loop in `rpc_psbt.py` to test all combiner test vectors in both forward and reversed input orders.
